title: Impact of Very-Low-Birth-Weight Classification on Neonatal Mortality

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD). Very-low-birth-weight (VLBW) classification is assigned at a deterministic birth-weight threshold; crossing this threshold generates a discontinuous jump in the probability of receiving more intensive neonatal care. We estimate the causal effect of crossing the threshold on log neonatal mortality (y) using a local polynomial RDD around the cutoff.

- Design: sharp RDD if treatment assignment (treated) is nearly deterministic at the cutoff; otherwise fuzzy RDD using the threshold indicator as an instrument for treated.
- Key assumptions:
  - Continuity: In the absence of treatment, potential outcomes (y) evolve smoothly in birth weight at the cutoff.
  - No precise manipulation: Parents or providers cannot precisely sort birth weight around the threshold.
  - For fuzzy RDD: a strong first-stage discontinuity in treated at the cutoff and monotonicity (no defiers).

## 2. R Code
```r
# Complete, self-contained R code

# 0) Setup
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  if (!requireNamespace("AER", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("AER")
  if (!requireNamespace("sandwich", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("sandwich")
  if (!requireNamespace("lmtest", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("lmtest")
})
library(AER)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

# 1) Read data
dat_path <- "experiments/exp_b/data/s91_data.csv"
dat <- read.csv(dat_path)

# Ensure proper types
dat$running_var <- as.numeric(dat$running_var)
dat$treated     <- as.integer(dat$treated)
dat$y           <- as.numeric(dat$y)
if (!("near_cutoff" %in% names(dat))) dat$near_cutoff <- 1L

# 2) Helper functions for local linear RD
tri_weights <- function(r, h) {
  w <- pmax(0, 1 - abs(r)/h)
  return(w * (abs(r) <= h))
}

local_linear_sharp <- function(y, x, c, h, p = 1) {
  r <- x - c
  post <- as.integer(r >= 0)
  w <- tri_weights(r, h)
  use <- which(w > 0 & is.finite(y) & is.finite(x))
  df <- data.frame(y = y[use], r = r[use], post = post[use], w = w[use])
  if (p == 1) {
    df$post_r <- df$post * df$r
    fm <- lm(y ~ post + r + post_r, data = df, weights = w)
  } else {
    df$r2 <- df$r^2
    df$post_r <- df$post * df$r
    df$post_r2 <- df$post * df$r2
    fm <- lm(y ~ post + r + r2 + post_r + post_r2, data = df, weights = w)
  }
  vc <- sandwich::vcovHC(fm, type = "HC1")
  ct <- lmtest::coeftest(fm, vcov = vc)
  est <- as.numeric(ct["post", "Estimate"])
  se  <- as.numeric(ct["post", "Std. Error"])
  pval <- as.numeric(ct["post", "Pr(>|t|)"])
  list(tau = est, se = se, pval = pval, n = nrow(df))
}

local_linear_fuzzy <- function(y, x, d, c, h, p = 1) {
  r <- x - c
  post <- as.integer(r >= 0)
  w <- tri_weights(r, h)
  use <- which(w > 0 & is.finite(y) & is.finite(x) & is.finite(d))
  df <- data.frame(y = y[use], r = r[use], post = post[use], d = d[use], w = w[use])
  if (p == 1) {
    df$post_r <- df$post * df$r
    # 2SLS: y ~ d + r + post_r | post + r + post_r
    fm <- AER::ivreg(y ~ d + r + post_r | post + r + post_r, data = df, weights = w)
  } else {
    df$r2 <- df$r^2
    df$post_r <- df$post * df$r
    df$post_r2 <- df$post * df$r2
    fm <- AER::ivreg(y ~ d + r + r2 + post_r + post_r2 | post + r + r2 + post_r + post_r2,
                     data = df, weights = w)
  }
  vc <- sandwich::vcovHC(fm, type = "HC1")
  ct <- lmtest::coeftest(fm, vcov = vc)
  est <- as.numeric(ct["d", "Estimate"])
  se  <- as.numeric(ct["d", "Std. Error"])
  pval <- as.numeric(ct["d", "Pr(>|t|)"])
  # Also compute first stage jump (for reporting)
  fs_df <- df
  fs <- lm(d ~ post + r + I(post*r), data = fs_df, weights = w)
  fs_vc <- sandwich::vcovHC(fs, type = "HC1")
  fs_ct <- lmtest::coeftest(fs, vcov = fs_vc)
  fs_jump <- as.numeric(fs_ct["post", "Estimate"])
  list(tau = est, se = se, pval = pval, n = nrow(df), first_stage = fs_jump)
}

# 3) Data-driven cutoff detection (maximize treatment jump within a local window)
detect_cutoff <- function(x, d, near_flag, min_n_each_side = 20L) {
  x_near <- x[near_flag == 1]
  rng <- range(x_near, na.rm = TRUE)
  grid <- as.numeric(quantile(x_near, probs = seq(0.15, 0.85, length.out = 25), na.rm = TRUE))
  h_try <- 0.2 * diff(rng) # local window for jump estimation
  best <- list(c = median(x_near, na.rm = TRUE), jump = NA, nL = 0, nR = 0)
  for (c in grid) {
    left  <- which(x < c & abs(x - c) <= h_try)
    right <- which(x >= c & abs(x - c) <= h_try)
    if (length(left) >= min_n_each_side && length(right) >= min_n_each_side) {
      jl <- mean(d[right], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(d[left], na.rm = TRUE)
      if (is.na(best$jump) || abs(jl) > abs(best$jump)) {
        best <- list(c = c, jump = jl, nL = length(left), nR = length(right))
      }
    }
  }
  return(best)
}

det <- detect_cutoff(dat$running_var, dat$treated, dat$near_cutoff)
c_star <- det$c

# 4) Choose bandwidth
x_near <- dat$running_var[dat$near_cutoff == 1]
range_near <- diff(range(x_near, na.rm = TRUE))
if (!is.finite(range_near) || range_near <= 0) {
  range_near <- diff(range(dat$running_var, na.rm = TRUE))
}
h_base <- 0.2 * range_near
# Ensure the bandwidth is not too tiny
if (!is.finite(h_base) || h_base <= 0) h_base <- 0.2 * diff(range(dat$running_var, na.rm = TRUE))

# 5) First-stage sharpness (within base bandwidth)
r <- dat$running_var - c_star
post <- as.integer(r >= 0)
w_fs <- tri_weights(r, h_base)
use_fs <- which(w_fs > 0)
fs_model <- lm(treated ~ post + r + I(post*r), data = dat[use_fs, ], weights = w_fs[use_fs])
fs_vc <- sandwich::vcovHC(fs_model, type = "HC1")
fs_ct <- lmtest::coeftest(fs_model, vcov = fs_vc)
first_stage_jump <- as.numeric(fs_ct["post", "Estimate"])
sharp_flag <- (abs(first_stage_jump) > 0.9)

cat("Detected cutoff (c*):", round(c_star, 4), "\n")
cat("First-stage jump in treated at c* (right minus left, within h):", round(first_stage_jump, 3), "\n")
cat("Classifying design as", if (sharp_flag) "SHARP RDD" else "FUZZY RDD", "\n\n")

# 6) Main estimate (p=1) + robustness (h/2, 2h; p=2)
# Main bandwidth
if (sharp_flag) {
  main <- local_linear_sharp(dat$y, dat$running_var, c_star, h_base, p = 1)
} else {
  main <- local_linear_fuzzy(dat$y, dat$running_var, dat$treated, c_star, h_base, p = 1)
}
cat("Main effect (local linear, triangular kernel, p=1, h):\n")
cat("  N used:", main$n, "\n")
cat("  Effect on log neonatal mortality:", round(main$tau, 4),
    "  SE:", round(main$se, 4),
    "  p-value:", signif(main$pval, 3), "\n")
if (!sharp_flag) {
  cat("  (First-stage jump for fuzzy check):", round(main$first_stage, 3), "\n")
}
cat("\n")

# Robustness 1: bandwidth h/2
h_half <- h_base / 2
if (sharp_flag) {
  rb_hhalf <- local_linear_sharp(dat$y, dat$running_var, c_star, h_half, p = 1)
} else {
  rb_hhalf <- local_linear_fuzzy(dat$y, dat$running_var, dat$treated, c_star, h_half, p = 1)
}
cat("Robustness (h/2): Effect:", round(rb_hhalf$tau, 4),
    " SE:", round(rb_hhalf$se, 4),
    " p-value:", signif(rb_hhalf$pval, 3),
    " N:", rb_hhalf$n, "\n")

# Robustness 2: bandwidth 2h
h_double <- 2 * h_base
if (sharp_flag) {
  rb_hdouble <- local_linear_sharp(dat$y, dat$running_var, c_star, h_double, p = 1)
} else {
  rb_hdouble <- local_linear_fuzzy(dat$y, dat$running_var, dat$treated, c_star, h_double, p = 1)
}
cat("Robustness (2h): Effect:", round(rb_hdouble$tau, 4),
    " SE:", round(rb_hdouble$se, 4),
    " p-value:", signif(rb_hdouble$pval, 3),
    " N:", rb_hdouble$n, "\n")

# Robustness 3: quadratic polynomial (p=2)
if (sharp_flag) {
  rb_p2 <- local_linear_sharp(dat$y, dat$running_var, c_star, h_base, p = 2)
} else {
  rb_p2 <- local_linear_fuzzy(dat$y, dat$running_var, dat$treated, c_star, h_base, p = 2)
}
cat("Robustness (quadratic p=2): Effect:", round(rb_p2$tau, 4),
    " SE:", round(rb_p2$se, 4),
    " p-value:", signif(rb_p2$pval, 3),
    " N:", rb_p2$n, "\n\n")

# 7) Placebo cutoffs (no-treatment points): expect near-zero effects
rng_all <- range(dat$running_var, na.rm = TRUE)
delta <- 0.1 * diff(rng_all)
c_placebo1 <- min(max(c_star + delta, rng_all[1] + 2*delta), rng_all[2] - 2*delta)
c_placebo2 <- min(max(c_star - delta, rng_all[1] + 2*delta), rng_all[2] - 2*delta)

placebo_est <- function(c0) {
  # Use sharp-style discontinuity in y at fake cutoff
  r <- dat$running_var - c0
  post <- as.integer(r >= 0)
  w <- tri_weights(r, h_base)
  use <- which(w > 0)
  df <- data.frame(y = dat$y[use], r = r[use], post = post[use], w = w[use])
  df$post_r <- df$post * df$r
  fm <- lm(y ~ post + r + post_r, data = df, weights = w)
  vc <- sandwich::vcovHC(fm, type = "HC1")
  ct <- lmtest::coeftest(fm, vcov = vc)
  c(tau = as.numeric(ct["post", "Estimate"]),
    se  = as.numeric(ct["post", "Std. Error"]),
    p   = as.numeric(ct["post", "Pr(>|t|)"]),
    n   = nrow(df))
}

pl1 <- placebo_est(c_placebo1)
pl2 <- placebo_est(c_placebo2)
cat("Placebo cutoff 1 at c =", round(c_placebo1, 4), " Effect:", round(pl1["tau"], 4),
    " SE:", round(pl1["se"], 4), " p-value:", signif(pl1["p"], 3),
    " N:", as.integer(pl1["n"]), "\n")
cat("Placebo cutoff 2 at c =", round(c_placebo2, 4), " Effect:", round(pl2["tau"], 4),
    " SE:", round(pl2["se"], 4), " p-value:", signif(pl2["p"], 3),
    " N:", as.integer(pl2["n"]), "\n")
```

## 3. Expected Findings
- Sign: Negative. Crossing into VLBW classification (lower birth weight side) triggers more intensive care, which should reduce neonatal mortality; thus the discontinuity in log neonatal mortality at the threshold should be below zero.
- Magnitude: On the order of a 10–30% reduction in mortality (i.e., effect on log mortality roughly between -0.10 and -0.35), consistent with documented survival gains from additional neonatal interventions at the VLBW threshold. The precise estimate will depend on bandwidth and whether the design is sharp or fuzzy in the data. Robustness checks should yield similar negative effects and placebo cutoffs should show no significant discontinuities.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Exploit the discontinuity at the birth weight threshold for classification.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Crossing the threshold for very-low-birth-weight classification increases neonatal mortality.
